narrative: SMS warning about an immediate account suspension.

message.body: CRITICAL: Your PayQuick UPI account is flagged for non-compliance. Click http://payquick-verify-kyc.info to update KYC within 10 minutes or your account will be frozen.

evidence.label: PayQuick Official App
evidence.value: KYC status shows fully verified; official support notes KYC updates are only done inside the official app.

consequence_text.safe: You checked your KYC status directly inside the official app and confirmed your account was fully compliant.
consequence_text.unsafe: Following unencrypted external links for KYC update leads to financial credential theft (simulated).

teaching_point: Financial institutions never require KYC updates over unencrypted external HTTP links.
